hashNormalization: UTF-8 source bytes; the publication uses LF line endings and .gitattributes keeps them on every platform.

derivedIdentifierTable.purpose: Local source-generator symbolic-name drift guard, not an upstream publication or NodeId source.
derivedIdentifierTable.derivationResult: All 238 published rows agree with the NodeSet on numeric id and node class; 86 symbolic names follow the generator conventions. The published table predates model 1.01 and lacks 67 of the 305 NodeSet declarations (for example AutoIdDiagnosticsEventType i=1010, AccessResult i=3017, RfidAccessResult i=3018 and WriteTagID i=7023). Their NodeIds come from the NodeSet; no rows are invented.

compatibility: RequiredModel entries are lower bounds: the package loads the DI model the SDK ships, which is newer than DI 1.01.
The NodeSet defines Default Binary and Default XML encodings only; JSON uses the DataType NodeIds.

AutoIdScanEventType subtypes and RfidAccessEventType refine the DataType of the ScanResult and AccessResult properties to a structure subtype. The generated subtype states expose those properties with the refined value type.
